Governmental funds Total expenditures 260,472 vs fund column totals 73,079 + 53,155 + 8,110 + 68,998 + 4,158 + 52,971 = 260,471; Miscellaneous total 39,476 vs columns 20,311 + 12,365 + 2,250 + 17 + 3,802 + 732 = 39,477; nonmajor column lines 38,474 + 3,067 + 3,704 + 6,995 + 732 = 52,972 vs printed 52,971 (rounding in the report).

notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); expenditures are listed by object with no function, so each uses the function of its largest funds (as in FY2023) with review; Operating expenses = Operating; statement capital outlay is mixed (Street 2,616, Cemetery and Park equipment 6,995), labelled plain Capital Outlay. Contributions 48,793 is mostly the ARPA fund column 47,433 (p7), recorded as federal grants with review. Hall Fund property (5) printed in red (negative). Governmental ending cash 1,007,139 and investments 219,581 as printed on p3 (county treasurer's balances 5,038 a separate line, not added); no beginning cash printed; the roll-forward uses fund balances. Business-type lines from the proprietary funds statement (p6, Total column; as FY2023), measure cash (net position is only cash and investments); receipts total computed (operating 1,092,831 + nonoperating investment earnings 1,074 + other 77,405 = 1,171,310, equal to the budget schedule's business-type actual on p8); transfers net 3 - 8,329. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows Sewer 48,891/66,769 and Water 79,923/32,376, while the proprietary statement (p6) prints those under Water and Sewer respectively; detail follows p6 column headings. Balance sheet: governmental lines from p3 (totals equal the government-wide governmental column 1,231,758), business-type from p1; component unit library excluded. Detail: per fund columns of the governmental funds statement (p4; Sinking Fund had no activity), the nonmajor statement (p7: Cemetery, Park, Keno, ARPA; Police no activity) and the proprietary statement (p6); the all-funds budget schedule (p8) is a combined single column and is not recorded (used only as evidence for functions: general government = General + Hall, culture and recreation = Pool + Park + Keno).
